title: Claude Driven RoN / Swat 4 Inspo Demo
author: tjh223
selftext:
demo link 

Built a ready or not / swat 4 inspired demo using Claude Opus 5.5 in an afternoon. All assets were created using Claude for modeling, animating, coding, and driving a unity project.

This post is just meant to be informative and share something I’ve built. I’ve always loved the idea of game development personally but have never had the time to fully ingratiate myself, as there are just so many components in making a good game. Building this demo energized me a bit because I know there are going to be some creatives out there that may be waiting on the sideline. It’s easier than ever to dive in and build a cool experience!!
